statement.zh: Petrie 以《Tarkhan I and Memphis V》(1913) 与《Tarkhan II》(1914) 正式报告塔尔罕前王朝末–早王朝墓地发掘。
statement.en: Petrie published the Tarkhan Late Predynastic–Early Dynastic cemetery excavations in Tarkhan I and Memphis V (1913) and Tarkhan II (1914).
